stoolFinal.sourceFloorRule: Use each actual foot-bottom boundary, not nominal1198. Different y values are perspective positions on the same floor, not different physical floor heights.

pullConstraint.personRootRule: No whole person+stool co-translation. Weight-bearing sole remains fixed while real elbow retracts; body may lean slightly but may not advance with stool. Artist to confirm the pose reach from original147 body.
pullConstraint.handRule: Hand contact=stool rigid grab713,823 plus current stool dx. No hand sliding along wood or detached thumb contour.

seatConstraint.currentBad156: Butt/hip remains ahead of seat; do not assign seat weight to current B.
seatConstraint.weightTransfer: Near sole supports first; back foot must visibly land and take weight before the near foot lifts. No both-foot slide.
seatConstraint.chairHighEnoughToRequireSupport: Follow team route: planted support then backstep/pivot, hip over seat, knee bend and first seat load while foot assists, then feet relax. If a distant fixed foot makes reach impossible, transfer support to the backstepped foot; do not stretch legs. A hand on the locked seat can share load, not an unshown unsupported jump.
seatConstraint.finalFeet: C natural hanging feet may remain only after seat bears weight. No shoe-floor contact shadow is added to hanging feet.
seatConstraint.pathRule: These are contact zones for artist alignment, not a command to slide an existing complete body across the floor.

proposedReturnExposure.stage: Rightward stool pull; support sole fixed within each weight phase, real grip follows rigid wood.
Stool stops; both feet absorb motion; no continued stool drift.
One foot supports while other steps/pivots left-back, lands and receives weight; butt moves above locked seat. T1 is above-seat, not seated.
Knees flex and butt lowers; T2 initial real seat load while foot still assists. Seat load must occur before foot unweights.
Fully seated, feet relax/hang naturally; hands collect only after support is secure.
Stable C-family seated gaze; preserve completed seat load, no head nod.
D arm collection after stable sitting.
